questionText: Which of the following is NOT a basic requirement of the linear programming problem (LPP)?

options.text: All decision variables should assume non-negative values.
There are a finite number of decision variables and a finite number of constraints.
All the elements of an LPP should be quantifiable.

detailedSolution:
